comparison.objective: Lower and lock a gas-spring overbed table at a marked height; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber for acceptable repeated dynamic stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires holding a release paddle while pressing a large tabletop, then releasing in order. Candidate requires recessed hex-key engagement, setscrew manipulation, fine collar rotation, and feedback-driven cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Record scores table height, lock stability, tilt, spring-back, and shin force. Candidate requires two non-bottoming physical cycles, retained collar setting, and no hard-stop/rebound/overload failure. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift, and locking-torque thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both involve adjustable damped mechanisms and locking, but they test different abilities: bimanual height positioning against a gas spring versus tool-mediated damper tuning validated through dynamic impacts.
